newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain on speculative support.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain on speculative support.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Monday rose to 1,182/1,183 rupees per quintal after falling to 1,177/1,178 rupees in early trade, dealers said.
"The market was down and oversold last week which prompted some short-covering today," a dealer said.
"Sentiment is still subdued amid higher supplies and slow overseas enquiries."
"Any gains from this level will turn shortlived," he said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained high at 37,000/38,000 bags (75 kg each) against the daily average of 30,000/35,000 bags last week.
Groundoil was steady at 342/343 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 50/60 tonnes while physical buying was at a low ebb. Imported palm oil was quiet at 277/278 rupees per 10 kg.

In Rajkot spot groundnut oil dropped by 4/5 rupees to 515/516 rupees per 15 kg. Sentiment for edible oils remained subdued amid rising new crop arrivals of rapeseed oil as well as continued inflows of imported sunflower oil at Indian ports.
